subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

I have made / the cupcakes, so / please hand out them / to me.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. please hand out them .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the phrase **"please hand out them"**, which is an incorrect construction.
 
• The correct structure for phrasal verbs like **"hand out"** requires the object pronoun (e.g., "them") to come before the particle (**"out"**).
 
• Thus, the correct phrase should be **"please hand them out"**.

Correct sentence: *I have made the cupcakes, so please hand them out to me*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Word Order in Phrasal Verbs:**
 
 
• When the object of a phrasal verb is a pronoun (e.g., "them"), it must come before the particle (e.g., "out").
 
• For example: **Correct:** Hand them out. **Incorrect:** Hand out them.
 
 
 
• **Direct and Indirect Objects:**
 
 
• In sentences with both a direct object (e.g., "cupcakes") and an indirect object (e.g., "to me"), the word order is important to convey clarity and grammatical accuracy.
